alternator_amps.source: estimate: lumped electrical supply; not the dual-generator wiring of an individual installation.

items.instruction: Maintain aircraft control; avoid abrupt manoeuvres.
Keep the canopy closed; latch only when fully closed and safe to reach.
Land at a suitable airfield if the canopy cannot be secured.

preflight.source: Sling 2 POH Rev 2.8 (DC-POH-002-X-B-2.8) section 4.4 Pre-flight check

items.text: Fuel level indicator: verify fuel quantity

Control system: visual inspection, free movement up to the stops, verify function
Safety harnesses: condition, security of attachment, operation of buckles
Seats: security of attachment, adjustment mechanism operates and locks after adjustment
Fire extinguisher: verify present and valid
